title: guidanceContext
responsibility: Loads committed or working registry context, caches source text, resolves active identities and combines catalog declarations with contract and source hints.

inputs.name: guidanceContext.options
inputs.description: Project root and optional additional required-state JSON paths. Guide reads HEAD; contract checks read the working tree. all selects every active stored contract.

inputs.name: guidanceContext.committed
inputs.description: True reads HEAD through the commit adapter; false reads tracked and untracked working source for contract review.

inputs.name: guidanceUnit.context
inputs.description: Loaded registry, indexed source, readable tree, declarations and per-invocation attribution caches.

inputs.name: guidanceUnit.id
inputs.description: Registered active identity; undefined selects all only when the options explicitly request all.

inputs.name: guidanceText.context
inputs.description: Loaded registry, indexed source, readable tree, declarations and per-invocation attribution caches.

inputs.name: guidanceText.path
inputs.description: Repository-relative source or test file to read from the selected tree, cached within this invocation.

inputs.name: namedUnitStates.context
inputs.description: Loaded registry, indexed source, readable tree, declarations and per-invocation attribution caches.

inputs.name: namedUnitStates.unit
inputs.description: Stored unit identity, source ownership and authored contract selected for this review.

inputs.name: sourceUnitStates.context
inputs.description: Loaded registry, indexed source, readable tree, declarations and per-invocation attribution caches.

inputs.name: sourceUnitStates.unit
inputs.description: Stored unit identity, source ownership and authored contract selected for this review.

inputs.name: allUnitStates.context
inputs.description: Loaded registry, indexed source, readable tree, declarations and per-invocation attribution caches.

inputs.name: allUnitStates.unit
inputs.description: Stored unit identity, source ownership and authored contract selected for this review.

outputs.name: guidanceContext
outputs.description: Registry and indexed source for the chosen tree, parsed state declarations and empty per-run source/test caches.

outputs.name: guidanceUnit
outputs.description: The stored active manifest matching the exact identity; retired or unknown identities are rejected.

outputs.name: guidanceText
outputs.description: Text read from the selected source tree, never borrowed from a different revision.

outputs.name: namedUnitStates
outputs.description: Default and named catalog or dedicated/unit-qualified scenario states; broader application coverage labels and inapplicable states are excluded.

outputs.name: sourceUnitStates
outputs.description: Guessed branch/type states from owned source and directly relevant status/type/progress dependencies; these do not establish visual proof.

outputs.name: allUnitStates
outputs.description: Named required unit states plus advisory contract/source boundaries, preserving provenance and upgrading a guess only when a unit declaration names it.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Rejects invalid selection, unknown identities, malformed inventories or invalid registry data with the specific CLI diagnostic.

errors.name: Dependency failure
errors.description: Propagates Git, filesystem, source-reader and evidence-validation failures from the invoked operation.
